purpose: F22 of the second independent review: the two legacy time-bound tests (chunked.test.cjs: 1.5 s close and 3 s GET bounds, chunked-process.test.cjs: 3.2 s bounds) were rewritten STRUCTURALLY: no time decides pass or fail, an attacker gives up only after a byte count, the server's own log counts the bytes it read, and a naive control is attacked in the same run. The rewritten files run against a NAIVE KEEP-ALIVE SUBJECT (the final server with the two close-after-refusal lines removed: no Connection: close, no close after the flushed answer) and must fail: the connections stay open and the server keeps reading an endless chunked body.
